gold_rules.rule_text: Captains averaged £6.5m in cost; premium assets (>=£9.5m) were captained 9.1% of the time.
Captains played at Home 72.7% of the time with an average FDR of 2.5 (FDR <= 2 in 45.5% of GWs).
Formation 4-3-3 was mathematically optimal in 27.3% of gameweeks.
Optimal transfers in averaged 11.8 pts in their debut GW vs 2.9 pts for players sold (net immediate gain: +8.9 pts per transfer).
Taking 42 hit(s) (-168 pts) was mathematically optimal to capture explosive upside across gameweeks.
Starting XI budget prioritized MID (36.3% of starting spend, avg £25.4m).
Optimal starting XIs leaned towards Home fixtures (52.9%) with an average FDR of 2.9 (easy FDR <= 2 in 34.7% of picks).
Budget (<£6.0m) offered the highest points-per-million (2.25 pts/£m) in the optimal starting XIs.
